subject.title: fix(gateway): replace buggy isPrivateOrLoopbackHost with canonical net.ts import

question: After the duplicate import is fixed, should maintainers require real gateway pricing-cache refresh proof for this external PR, or explicitly waive that proof gate?
rationale: Automation cannot verify the contributor's real setup, and the changed compatibility-sensitive classifier affects catalog-fetch decisions for configured provider URLs.

options.title: Require real gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a real gateway pricing-cache refresh showing a CGNAT/private endpoint skipped and a public endpoint still fetched.

options.title: Accept source-only evidence
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally waive the proof gate after the import defect is fixed, relying on source inspection and focused tests while owning the compatibility risk.

recommendation.title: Require real gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output or logs from a real gateway pricing-cache refresh showing a CGNAT/private endpoint skipped and a public endpoint still fetched.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent model-pricing-cache ownership makes this the strongest routing candidate for the proof-sufficiency and merge-readiness call.
